sources.entry: Web Assets Generator Skill by Alon Wolenitz - Easily generate web assets from Claude Code including favicons, app icons (PWA), and social media meta images (Open Graph) for Facebook, Twitter, WhatsApp, and LinkedIn. Handles image resizing, text-to-image generation, emojis, and provides proper HTML meta tags.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code Skill that generates favicons, PWA app icons, and Open Graph social media images from a logo, text, or emoji.
summary.what_it_does: The skill lets Claude Code generate web assets through conversation. It produces favicons (16×16, 32×32, 96×96, favicon.ico), app icons for PWA/mobile (180×180, 192×192, 512×512), and social share images for Open Graph (1200×630, 1200×675) used by Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, and WhatsApp. It can resize an existing image, render text into an image, and render emojis using a curated set of 60+ options with suggestions. It can also auto-generate a manifest.json with icons, colors, and settings, and generate HTML meta tags. Validation covers file sizes, dimensions, formats, and WCAG contrast. The README says it can detect the framework (e.g., Next.js, Astro) and offer to insert the tags into code.
use_cases: Create favicons for a website from a logo or emoji
Generate PWA and mobile app icons
Make Open Graph or Twitter card images for blog posts
Produce HTML meta tags for social sharing
Validate icon sizes and WCAG contrast
how_to_run: pip install pilmoji 'emoji<2.0.0' (optional, for emoji support)
Restart Claude Code, then ask e.g. 'Create a favicon with a rocket emoji'
Direct script use: python scripts/generate_favicons.py --emoji "🚀" output/ all
notable: Works through natural-language requests inside Claude Code, with a skill that Claude invokes automatically
Covers favicons, PWA icons, and social Open Graph images in one tool
Emoji rendering with 60+ curated emojis and suggestions
Includes WCAG contrast and file validation checks
Can also be used directly via Python scripts without Claude
caveats: Emoji support requires the optional pilmoji install and emoji<2.0.0 pin
WebP/AVIF formats and Pinterest/Instagram support are listed as not yet done (roadmap)
Requires Claude Code 2.0.13 or later and Python 3.6+
